% Mass conservation (strong form)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A1-mass}
\nabla\!\cdot\!(\rho\mathbf{v}) + \frac{\partial}{\partial t} \rho{\left(x,y,t \right)} = 0
\end{equation}

% x-momentum conservation
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A1-mom-x}
\partial_t(\rho u) + \partial_x(\rho u^{2} + p) + \partial_y(\rho u v) = 0
\end{equation}

% y-momentum conservation
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A1-mom-y}
\partial_t(\rho v) + \partial_x(\rho u v) + \partial_y(\rho v^{2} + p) = 0
\end{equation}

% Total-energy density
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A1-E}
E \;=\; \frac{p}{\gamma - 1} \;+\; \tfrac{1}{2}\rho\,(u^{2} + v^{2})
\end{equation}

% Total-energy conservation
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A1-energy}
\partial_t E + \partial_x\!\left[(E + p)\,u\right] + \partial_y\!\left[(E + p)\,v\right] = 0
\end{equation}

% Enthalpy and energy-flux factorisation
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A1-enthalpy-flux}
h \;\equiv\; e_{\mathrm{int}} + \frac{p}{\rho} = \frac{\gamma\,p}{(\gamma-1)\,\rho},\qquad (E + p)\,v_i \;=\; \rho\!\left(h + \tfrac{1}{2}|\mathbf{v}|^{2}\right) v_i
\end{equation}

% Momentum, material-derivative (non-conservative) form
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A1-material-mom}
\rho\,D_t u = -\partial_x p, \qquad \rho\,D_t v = -\partial_y p, \qquad D_t \;\equiv\; \partial_t + u\,\partial_x + v\,\partial_y
\end{equation}

% Internal-energy evolution (first law along a particle trajectory)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A1-material-e}
\rho\,D_t e_{\mathrm{int}} = -\,p\,\nabla\!\cdot\!\mathbf{v}, \qquad e_{\mathrm{int}} = \frac{p}{(\gamma - 1)\,\rho}
\end{equation}

% Compact conservative form
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A1-compact}
\partial_t \mathbf{U} + \partial_x \mathbf{F}_x(\mathbf{U}) + \partial_y \mathbf{F}_y(\mathbf{U}) = \mathbf{0}, \qquad \mathbf{U} = (\rho,\,\rho u,\,\rho v,\,E)^{\!\top}
\end{equation}

% x-flux vector
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A1-Fx}
\mathbf{F}_x(\mathbf{U}) = \begin{pmatrix}\rho u\\ \rho u^{2} + p\\ \rho u v\\ (E + p)\,u\end{pmatrix}
\end{equation}

% y-flux vector
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A1-Fy}
\mathbf{F}_y(\mathbf{U}) = \begin{pmatrix}\rho v\\ \rho u v\\ \rho v^{2} + p\\ (E + p)\,v\end{pmatrix}
\end{equation}
